q: The Stone-Weierstrass theorem generalises the Weierstrass approximation theorem. It states that a subalgebra A of C(K,ℝ) that separates points and contains constants is:
opts: Dense in C(K,ℝ) in the sup-norm
Dense only if K is compact and metrizable
exp: Stone-Weierstrass: if A ⊂ C(K,ℝ) is a subalgebra that separates points and contains a nonzero constant, then Ā = C(K,ℝ) in the uniform norm. The complex version requires additionally that A is closed under conjugation.
